Test a change.  
Learn from the results.  
Keep improving.

Convenient Self-Improvement, Powered by AI

Top of Mind is your next generation achievement and wellbeing tracker that is powered by AI to give you new insights and improve your productivity.

TOP OF MIND IS FOCUSED ON:

1) Convenient entries that take less than 75 seconds to complete - we think quicker, smaller entries that you actually do is a better plan than bigger essays that you keep putting off because you don't have time

2) Effortless analysis to see trends and patterns over time - so you can get a sense for how your achievements and wellbeing are trending over time and key triggers for your best days

3) Automated next-level insights and clear action plans - because you shouldn't have to be an expert staring at numbers and charts to get a deeper understanding and improve your own productivity and wellbeing

HOW DOES IT WORK?

Daily Entries:
- First, download and install Top of Mind on your mobile device. We'll take you through a short walk-through that helps you easily input your first entry.
- Once you are setup, you'll have a chance to "backfill" entries from the perspective of the past few days. This is optional, but can help you get up to speed more quickly and get you in the groove of submitting entries.
- Each entry will ask you a few questions to make it easier for you to fill out - you'll quickly input how you're feeling and what has been going on for the day so far, what your daily goals are, and then we'll ask a few custom 'Prompted Response' questions that will change over time.
- No need to think too hard while filling these out - the goal is just to keep it to whatever is Top of Mind for you! We have a "soft" time limit of 75 seconds for each entry to keep you on pace and encourage you to not spend too long.
- Over time, you'll see your entries fill up your timeline - you'll easily be able to review your old entries and add self-reflection comments as you look back on the older entries with the perspective of hindsight.

Analysis:
- Once you have a few entries submitted (don't forget you can backfill entries to get up and running more quickly!), you'll see the automated charts and analysis tab begin to populate
- Here you'll be able to track your trends over time and easily see how things have changed week-to-week or month-to-month
- You'll also be able to keep track of key words and triggers related to your good days and bad days and how those have changed over time

Insights and Action Plans:
- In addition to the automated charts and analysis that you can review yourself, the weekly Insights and Action Plans provide an even deeper level of detail and clarity
- Each week, embedded AI can anonymously analyze your entries, self-reflection comments, trends, and patterns to provide you with an easy-to-read report of insights into your recent productivity and wellbeing and clear action steps you can take over the next week to try to improve
- If you've been looking at achievement and mood charts and asking yourself "so what...?" - this will help answer for you
- The Insights and Action Plans feature is limited to Top of Mind Premium members - but everyone gets a 1-week free trial period and we make it easy to unlock additional free weeks by referring others to Top of Mind

OTHER

Top of Mind is built and based in New York. We're always adding new features, so if you have anything you'd like to see please reach out to us at contact@top-of-mind.app and let us know.

Missing out on what life has to offer because of low self esteem? Get your self-esteem back on track with research-backed methods based on Cognitive Behavioural Therapy. Join 100,000+ people who already enjoy more confidence!

HOW CAN IMPROVING SELF-LOVE BE SO SIMPLE?
We tend to overcomplicate things. Research shows our mind can learn and adapt by using the power of helpful thinking. There are multiple published studies that show this app to be effective for body image, obsessions, self esteem and even depression!

What's the story behind the app?
The app is the result of collaboration between a game developer and a clinical psychologist. When we created this app, we wanted it to be as effective as possible, and to take only 3 minutes a day to complete and improve. So when we published the first version, Prof. Guy Doron began researching the impact of the daily training. We found that within 14 days, users managed to build mental resilience that lasted for additional 30 days!

IMPROVING CONFIDENCE IS SIMPLE
Throw away your negative thoughts. Accept your positive thoughts. Learn to identify your inner conversation and respond to real life thoughts. Train daily and improve your self esteem and wellness.

SCIENCE BACKED
New findings support the effectiveness of the core mechanism used in GGTUDE's apps.
According to CBT models, negative self talk – individuals’ interpretations of the self, others and the world - maintain psychological difficulties such as low self esteem, mood, and maladaptive behavior. 

HOW DO I BUILD MY SELF-ESTEEM?
The foundations of healthy confidence and self esteem are built upon beliefs. Our beliefs have the potential to bias and affect our ability to deal with daily situations. For example, if I believe that "everything in myself needs to be prefect", I won't be able to live up to these expectations and my confidence will decrease.

BELIEFS AND SELF TALK
Beliefs and self talk are interrelated. Once we learn to embrace healthier and more adaptive self-talk, it can change our beliefs and help us get rid of the ones that negatively affect our confidence and self esteem.

IS THIS APP SIMILAR TO PSYCHOLOGICAL THERAPY?
Our app platform is not designed to be used as a therapy or treatment, however:
1. It is being used by CBT therapists as a complementing tool.
2. It helps in maintaining self esteem during or after therapy.
3. It is found to relieve symptoms of anxiety, worries, obsessions and more. 

HELPFUL THINKING
The basic task in the app is simple - you will be presented with thoughts. If the thought promotes unhelpful self talk - throw it away by swiping it up. If the thought promotes positive or helpful thinking, accept it by swiping it down.

The more we train, the more automatic this process becomes.
 
HOW MUCH SHOULD I TRAIN EACH DAY?
To feel better and improve your confidence, start today! GG Apps are designed to be most effective in short training sessions. You are advised to complete up to 3 levels per day, which should only take between 3-4 minutes.

LEVELS AND TOPICS
The app's many topics and themes are broken down into more than 500 levels. Each level has a pool of self talk statements (or thoughts).
The topics include: self esteem, belief in change, self criticism, negative thinking, coping, positive boost, comparing, perfectionism, emotions, social fears, self as an object, danger and threat, seeing the beauty, fear of abandonment, and more.

You can also test yourself to see how well your confidence progresses with our self assessment tool.

LEARN MORE ABOUT THE FACTS BEHIND GGTUDE APPS

Most people have no idea why they're stuck. Not because the answer is hidden — because nobody asks the right questions.
Lifescan asks 42 of them, across your body, money, presence, people, love and purpose, written with people who work in each of those fields. A few nobody has ever asked you. Six minutes. No sugarcoating.
Then it gives you 30 days to change what it found.

THE SCAN IS FREE:
• 42 questions. Good questions are sometimes worth more than answers.
• Your archetype, 1 of 67, and how uncommon it is
• Your blind spot's name
• A first look at what the scan found

YOUR RESULTS OPEN WITH A SUBSCRIPTION:
Weekly or yearly (in the US, $7.99/week or $39.99/year; the App Store shows your local price). Either one opens everything:
• Your six scores and your life score
• Your 30-day program, built from your answers (below)
• The sentence the scan wrote about you, finished, and your blind spot explained
• Your archetype in full, every pattern, every superpower
• Your Scanny, hatched
• An AI analysis of your answers, if you say yes
Weekly is your results plus a week to start building your habits and see what progress looks like. Yearly is a year — enough to change the whole thing. Cancel any time in Settings.

YOUR 30 DAYS:
The scan shows where you stand. The program is how you move. It's built from your answers, and your weakest areas get more of the 30 days.
• Today's focus: a task a day, chosen from your answers. You pick the pace: 5, 10 or 20 minutes a day.
• Habits, daily or weekly, each with its own streak.
• A growth plan for each of the six areas, in Do, Learn and Habit steps. Finish steps and they unlock insights about you.
• A day streak, plus freezes you earn by doing extra, so one missed day doesn't wipe it.
• A life-score goal for the month, set by your pace.
• After day 30 your scores are recalculated from what you actually did, and a before-and-after shows what moved. Then the next month starts.
You scan once. After that your scores move only through what you do.

NOT A PERSONALITY QUIZ:
Lifescan uses behavioral questions — not self-ratings — because what you do is more honest than what you think about yourself. It scores six life dimensions:
• Body (Vessel) — sleep, energy, fitness, physical health
• Money (Stack) — income, savings, financial stress, career
• Presence (Aura) — confidence, social energy, how rooms respond to you
• People (Roots) — friendships, support network, real connections
• Love (Heart) — romantic quality, emotional vulnerability, intimacy
• Purpose (Signal) — direction, meaning, what you're building toward
Then it cross-references them. High money but low relationships? That's a pattern. Great body but no direction? That gap is costing you more than you think. Your blind spots sit in those connections, the ones most assessments miss. Your archetype, 1 of 67 (The Drifter, The Burnout, The Successful Loner, The Operator, The Magnetic…), comes from your exact scores, not a random label.

When things get tough, Self is what you open.

A guided journaling and mood tracking app for hard moments. Not a meditation app. Not a blank page. Something active — matched to how you feel right now.

You tap your mood. Self reads it, guides you through a short breathing reset and a single journal prompt, then closes with a piece of Stoic wisdom. In less than 5 minutes. And it works.

The method behind it is Stoic philosophy — two thousand years old, built specifically for hard days. Marcus Aurelius didn't write the Meditations to build a morning routine. He journaled to work through difficult moments. Self is that same practice, rebuilt for today.

---

HOW A SESSION WORKS

Four steps. Three to ten minutes.

1. Check-in — one tap to say how you feel right now
2. Breathing — a short reset to settle your nervous system
3. Journal — one prompt to process what's underneath
4. Wisdom — a Stoic anchor to close and carry forward

The app reads your mood and routes you to the right session. You don't choose — you just say how you feel.

---

WHAT SELF TRACKS

Every check-in is logged. Over time you see your mood patterns — which days are harder, which moments trigger what, how sessions shift your state. That's not data for data's sake. It's clarity about yourself that's hard to get any other way.

---

THE DIFFERENCE

Headspace tells you to breathe and accept. Self gives you something to do with the hard feeling.

Other journal apps give you a blank page. Self gives you the right prompt after a session that's already shifted something.

Passive wellness doesn't move the needle. Guided journaling does.

---

BUILT FOR YOU IF:
— Anxiety or overthinking is costing you clarity
— You feel stuck or unmotivated and can't work out why
— You want to track your mood and actually understand it
— You've tried meditation and it doesn't quite cut through
— You need a tool for hard moments, not a new daily obligation

---

results.description:
NOTE: This app is not intended as a substitute for therapy, or for advice from a trained medical professional. 

Nietzsche famously said “What doesn’t kill me makes me stronger”. But most people have no real way of turning problems into opportunities.

Enter The Tools app, based on the psychotherapeutic paradigm developed by Barry Michels MSW and Dr. Phil Stutz. The app teaches you to deal with four common problems (avoidance, resentment, insecurity, and negative thinking) with quick techniques called Tools. 

Changing your response to problems means real-time behavioural change. If you can't stop succumbing to temptation or shying away from problems, it’s not your fault. You just didn’t have the right Tools in your toolbox – until now.  



FAQ: 

Q: “What is a Tool?”

A: A Tool is a 3-5 second visualization, done at the moment you experience a problem. Using a Tool changes your inner state rapidly, helping you resolve symptoms (e.g. stress) and transmute problems (e.g. procrastination) into potential.


Q: “How were The Tools created?”

A: In short, free association (a la Freud), except it was the doctor, not the patient, doing the associating. When a patient had a problem that needed fixing, Dr. Stutz would ad-lib a solution; these spontaneous ideas were precursors to the Tools in the app. The patient would try the solution, and Dr. Stutz would refine the Tool over hundreds of trials and with scores of patients.


Q: “Isn’t using a Tool every time I have a problem too much work?”

A: Using Tools regularly takes energy in the short run, but increases your energy in the long run. Plus, each Tool only takes ~3 seconds to use. If you use a Tool 20 times a day, you’ve spent 1 minute. You’ll find it to be a bargain, because Tools help you solve your biggest problems and resolve your worst symptoms.


Q: “How will I know that a Tool worked?”

A: The point of a Tool is to change your inner state; feeling a change in state (e.g. going from avoidant to confident) is a strong sign that the Tool is working. But a change in state only matters because state impacts behaviour, so a change in behaviour (e.g. doing the thing you were avoiding) is the strongest sign that the Tool worked.


Q: “I followed the instructions but I can’t get myself to visualize ‘correctly’, and/or I don’t feel anything. What’s wrong?”

A: Using Tools is a skill you need to learn, and it helps to think of it that way – practice hard. Tools can also feel different for each person, and you’re encouraged to customize them to make them work for you.

But doesn’t really matter if you can’t visualize well – what matters is that you use a Tool and experience a change in state, followed by a change in behaviour. If that happens, don't worry that you can't see what you're 'meant' to see.


Q: “What’s the payoff for using Tools?”

A: You’ll be able to solve your worst problems. Symptoms such as anxiety can abate. 

But disciplined Tool use does much more than returning you to baseline. Using The Tools will touch every part of your life, allowing you to unlock abilities you didn’t know you had. It will also have a spillover effect on the people around you. 

Lastly, using a Tool can make even a moment of suffering meaningful and empowering. No matter what your struggle, using Tools will give you a sense of vitality and meaning. The Tools are an antidote to nihilism (but only if you work hard).

Forge Your Path to Glory

Imagine stepping into an arena where the challenge isn't against another, but against the self. Here, discipline clashes with temptation, and willpower battles ease. Embrace the Warrior Ethos

Every warrior's journey begins with a single decision—to fight. But what are you fighting for? Is it for control over your impulses, the strength to face the cold shock of reality without flinching, or the glory of achieving what few dare to dream? In this arena, your battles are fought in the gym, under the cold rush of a morning shower, and in the quiet moments of reflection.

--------------------

Tools for the Conquest

The Streak – Your victories are not marked by the scars of battle but by the days you conquer yourself. Track your streak; each day is a notch on your belt, a step closer to the ultimate victory.

War Room Reports – You're not in this alone. Every warrior needs a shield-brother. Someone to watch your back when the shadows of temptation loom. Report in, stand strong together, and keep each other honest in the pursuit of greatness.

SOS – The Battle Cry – In moments of weakness, when the sirens of temptation sing their sweetest tune, sound the battle cry. Instantly rally support, wisdom, and strength from AI-driven mentors who equip you with the weapons to fend off any assault.

The Warrior’s Breath – When the fog of war sets in, find clarity in the breath of the warrior. A built-in breathing timer helps you center your spirit, sharpen your focus, and ready your mind for the challenges ahead.

Words of the Wise – What did the great warriors of the past say in the face of adversity? Arm yourself with daily quotes that fortify your resolve, inspire action, and remind you why you started this path.

--------------------

The Arena Awaits

This is more than a path to self-mastery; it's a daily conquest, a relentless pursuit of the warrior’s peak. Every day provides a new battle, a fresh opportunity to prove your mettle, forge your will, and emerge victorious.

--------------------

Will You Answer the Call?

Join us. The arena is ready, the other warriors are prepared, and your legend awaits. This is where you fight the battles that matter. This is where you reclaim your power. This is where you learn that the greatest victory is the triumph over oneself.

Reboot Warriors – Because the true conquest is the conquest of self.
